source: BGB sections 557a, 557b, 558, 558a, 558b, 559, 559b; Berlin Kappungsgrenzenverordnung of 14 March 2023 (GVBl. p. 112); Berliner Mietspiegel 2026 of 28 May 2026 (ABl. no. 22).

leaseTypes.label: Ordinary lease
leaseTypes.note: The rent is whatever the contract says and the landlord has to ask for every rise.

leaseTypes.label: Staffelmiete
leaseTypes.note: Steps are written into the contract. While a Staffelmiete runs, a comparable-rent rise and a modernisation rise are both blocked (section 557a(2) BGB).

leaseTypes.label: Indexmiete
leaseTypes.note: The rent follows the national consumer price index. A comparable-rent rise is excluded (section 557b(2) BGB), and the rent has to sit still for a year between changes.
